contexts.text: My spirit shall not for ever reprove man () = that man is not thus led any longer...

After the Flood, in place of perception there succeeded conscience, by which he could be convicted; wherefore by conviction by the Spirit of Jehovah is signified an inward dictate, either perception or conscience...
As many as I love I rebuke and chasten ()... To rebuke = temptation as to falsities; and to chasten, temptation as to evils. AE 246.
(This) is to charge God with unmercifulness...
(This) is to charge the Lord with injustice.
